decisions.reason: The FTC and Fubini suppliers require nondegenerate intervals. Added an explicit zero-width four-side cancellation case without narrowing the Statement; corrected F3 to require integrable sections and verified continuous sections in step 2.1. The ordinary positive-area curl calculation is unchanged.

For an edge tail-to-head incidence row (-1,+1), outgoing electric flux is -G^T M_e e, not G^T M_e e. Corrected physical Gauss charge to -G^T M_e e=rho and continuity to rho(next)-rho-dt G^T(total current)=0. The Ampere and Faraday updates and all mass matrices are unchanged. The prior physical charge interface had the opposite sign.

The displayed fields satisfy both divergence equations with zero charge, and direct differentiation proves Faraday and Ampere precisely for J_src=0 and sigma=0. Made this source-free lossless instance explicit in Example, Given and F1, removing the unjustified omission of impressed current. The claimed cavity mode and frequency are preserved.

The curl ODE is a legitimate evolution for every initial face vector, but DC=0 only preserves divergence and does not impose the physical magnetic constraint. Added the explicit requirement Db(0)=0 for the constrained Maxwell interpretation and proved its preservation directly, retaining the full arbitrary-data coefficient ODE and full magnetic space.

F1 wrongly described the PEC closure as the ordinary boundary quotient; corrected it to the actual mixed restriction retaining all faces and cells. The existing PEC restriction calculation remains valid. Replaced simplex-only absolute calculations by the established cellular incidence and boundary-square-zero results, covering rectangular Yee faces and arbitrary cellular attachments while retaining the Statement.

The defining equation already gives a_+(u-R_hu,v_h)=0 by subtraction. The cited well-definedness lemma explicitly proves this identity in proof step 1.2 and uses it for Pythagorean best approximation in step 2.1. Thus the attribution is mathematically supported by the actual cited argument although its Statement does not separately list orthogonality; no item edit is needed.

The original assertion of a C1 IVP solution included T=0, whereas the matrix supplier expressly declines any singleton-domain derivative. Preserved positive-time existence and uniqueness and added the mathematically valid zero-time unique-map and constant-load continuation clause. The augmented matrix proof now separates these cases and invokes its supplier only on nondegenerate intervals.

A1 accurately describes inherited assumptions: the cited Ritz definition explicitly assumes Countable Choice in the edge/face branch, its FE supplier explicitly identifies H(div)/Piola inheritance, and def-na-hdiv-space and def-covariant-contravariant-piola-maps-and-hdiv-hcurl each explicitly assume Countable Choice. The finite Gram matrix proof makes no further choice. No unsupported strengthening or item repair is present.

Step 2.1 invoked a canonical interpolation rate without the suppliers aligned-interface and cellwise C1 hypotheses. A tangential jump in a piecewise constant divergence-free field can have zero piecewise derivative bound while not belonging to the mesh RT0 space, contradicting the original derivative-only O(h) estimate on cut cells. Made the approved mesh-aligned smooth-data assumptions explicit for the rate and F3; divergence compatibility and curl orthogonality still hold independently of that rate qualification.

The displayed identity in step 4.1 has the wrong sign: w(n)=bar w(n-1)+dt V(n-1)/2. Corrected it and explicitly separated n=0, which the initialization controls. The triangle-inequality curl bound is unchanged by the sign; the Rayleigh estimate dt sqrt(lambda_max)<2, forced square-root energy estimate and Faraday residual sum still establish the stated uniform second-order error.

Exact conventions: oriented edge boundary is head minus tail, hence physical electric charge is -G^T M_e e and physical continuity is rho(next)-rho-dt G^T(total current)=0. Field updates and material matrices are unchanged. PEC remains the mixed closure retaining all magnetic faces and cells.

Stokes Statement preserved, including zero widths: step 1.1 explicitly uses the oriented four-side parameterization in degenerate cases. F3 now has the source section-integrability qualification and step 2.1 checks continuity of all sections. Local supplier Statements actually read: cor-vector-valued-ftc-and-lipschitz-bound, thm-continuous-on-a-rectangle-is-riemann-integrable, thm-riemann-fubini-on-product-rectangles.

Incidence Statement preserved. Corrected the PEC restatement and used the existing published thm-cellular-boundary-is-the-incidence-degree-matrix and lem-the-cellular-boundary-squares-to-zero, whose complete local proofs were read, to support general cells. Their incidence coefficients and exact-sequence proof establish consecutive boundary maps compose to zero. Added these two existing dependencies to the assigned item and owning manifest; no new prerequisite was authored.

FE Definition explicitly distinguishes the arbitrary-data coefficient ODE from physical magnetic-compatible data Db(0)=0. The ODE Statement preserves positive-time existence and adds the unique singleton map and constant-load continuation at T=0; it never asserts a singleton-domain derivative. Read the full current published matrix-ODE supplier and its explicit singleton qualification.

Ritz definition unchanged: its equation directly gives orthogonality, and the actual well-definedness proof step 1.2 proves it. Well-definedness lemma unchanged: H(div), affine Piola, Whitney, FE and Ritz suppliers explicitly carry Countable Choice; no stronger choice axiom is introduced by any repair.

Magnetic projection rate now explicitly requires the approved aligned material/field interfaces and cellwise C1 derivative bounds of lem-maxwell-nedelec-smooth-interpolation-estimate. Read that complete local interpolation proof, the full/relative bounded-projection interface and its proof, and the Whitney moment/subcomplex argument. The Gram projection and divergence/curl-orthogonality claims remain intact. The direct error-theorem consumer already supplies the rate hypotheses.

Yee proof step 4.1 now has the plus sign in Cw(n)=C bar-w(n-1)+dt CV(n-1)/2, and treats n=0 by the initial bound. Direct checks of the recurrence, energy increment, strict-CFL Rayleigh bound and Faraday residual sum support the unchanged second-order Statement.
